To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the C-terminal arm structure of HU-1 and HU-2 proteins is a domain for DNA-binding, that the basicity of this region is required for DNA-binding, and that a unique aa structure of the arm is required for efficient DNA-binding and HU activity.
the C-terminal arm region of HU-1 or HU-2 is essential for DNA binding, but the arm region is not essential for supporting Mu phages.
a positively charged arm domain of HupA protein is essential for DNA binding, and that the DNA affinity of this protein can be modulated by aa changes in the arm domain.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the arm domain in the DNA-binding function of HU-1.
the DNA-binding properties of the HU- 2 protein, which is involved in the initiation of Mu transposition and the control of the expression of some bacterial genes.
the role of the arm domain of HUPA gene product in the binding of HU protein to DNA and in the HU activity for Mu phage development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the arm domain is important for DNA binding and that a positive charge of the arm domain contributes to the affinity to DNA, but is not essential.
the C-terminal arm region is a DNA-binding domain and that the positive charge of this domain is important for the DNA-binding activity.
the arm domain of HUPA is a DNA binding domain and that an increased positive charge in this domain increases the DNA binding ability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a positive charge of the arm domain is required for efficient DNA binding, and that the DNA binding ability of the HU-1 protein is lower than that of the HU2-1 protein.
the arm domain of HUPA is a DNA-binding domain, and the basicity of the N-terminal arm domain is an important factor in the interaction of HU-1/2 with DNA.
the HU-1 and HU-2 proteins have different DNA-binding affinities, and the HU-4 protein has an intermediate affinity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the arm domain is an important domain for DNA binding by HU.

the arm region is an important domain for the binding of HU to DNA, and that the basicity and the aa sequence of the N-terminal beta-ribbon of this domain determine the binding affinity of HU to its target sites.
the arm domain of HupA plays a role in DNA binding, and that a positively charged arm domain is essential for HU to function as an efficient DNA binding protein.
